evidence.fact: News tone is editorial coverage, not investors’ expected-return positioning. A capped query-dependent corpus, multilingual repeats, retrospective timestamps, refresh lag and smoothing can create false predictive timing. Historical2017description cannot authenticate today’s coverage or first publication.
evidence.limit: No API/tonechart/articles/underlying publishers extracted. GDELT does not confer underlying publishers’ extraction rights. Recheck only a distinct current-source question, not replay this old documentation. No market reaction or positive performance paper consulted.
evidence.passage: Document API combines machine-translated news, mean tone/coverage and query-dependent article lists. ArticleList defaults to75/max250; modes differ, and smoothing shifts peaks. Rolling3month wording also coexists with back-to-Jan2017 wording.
